pages.text: A Rivertear is an Arcane Gem formed from a blue-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in a pendeloque cut.$(br2)When activated, a Rivertear will conjure a block of water at a distance of up to 40 blocks at the cost of one point of charge.

Astral Sorcery Lightwell When placed in a Lightwell with access to the sky, a Rivertear generates water at an extremely rapid rate. While it's possible for a Rivertear to shatter, the chances of shattering are $()$(italic)astronomically$() unlikely. For all intents and purposes, a Rivertear lasts indefinitely unless its Lightwell is broken. Once placed in a Lightwell, a Rivertear cannot be retrieved.

Petal Apothecary If you have a Rivertear somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:arcanearchives:items/gemsocket)Gem Socket$(/l)), right clicking on a Petal Apothecary will refill it with water.
Crucible If you have a Rivertear somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:arcanearchives:items/gemsocket)Gem Socket$(/l)), right clicking on a Crucible will refill it with water.
Rivertears can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
